sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 220. Success value 100. 2x physical damage (Dark).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Removes buffs.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 90. Paralyzes for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 90. Applies psychological contamination for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Removes 30 Cost.
-Target: yourself. Applies Serenity for 60 seconds (increases max HP, DEF, and MDEF by 100%; nullifies debuffs and Cost reduction. After the effect ends, your character's Unison gauge is filled by 100).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 7000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 7000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all enemies. Reduces Unison gauge gains by 3 for 60 seconds.
Only [Loony] Yui can be used as Unlocking Potential material
